title: Holiday writing plan
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 2: Local area, holiday and travel: travel and holidays (2.2, 2.1)
source: Written for arabic/y10 lesson 18 (Pupil PDF worksheet: holiday writing plan)
intro: Lesson 18: Holidays: preferences, destinations and past experiences. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

panels.title: Preferences
points: لَا أُحِبُّ العُطَلَ فِي المُدُنِ الكَبِيرَةِ

arabic.text:
فِي الصَّيْفِ المَاضِي سَافَرْتُ مَعَ عَائِلَتِي إِلَى مَكَّةَ لِأَدَاءِ العُمْرَةِ.
نَزَلْنَا فِي فُنْدُقٍ قَرِيبٍ مِنَ الحَرَمِ، وَكَانَ الطَّقْسُ حَارًّا جِدًّا.
بَعْدَ ذٰلِكَ زُرْنَا أَقَارِبَنَا فِي جُدَّةَ.
فِي المُسْتَقْبَلِ سَأَزُورُ المَدِينَةَ المُنَوَّرَةَ إِنْ شَاءَ اللهُ.

questions.q: Say: last year I visited my relatives in Pakistan.
questions.a: فِي السَّنَةِ المَاضِيَةِ زُرْتُ أَقَارِبِي فِي بَاكِسْتَان

questions.q: Exam-style writing (our own) in the portal response box, 100 words: 'صِفْ عُطْلَةً قُمْتَ بِهَا، وَأَيْنَ تُرِيدُ أَنْ تَذْهَبَ فِي المُسْتَقْبَلِ.' Use three time frames and two opinions.
questions.a: Three time frames, opinions with reasons, accurate past tense

questions.q: Extend: Group A (4AA1): write a three-sentence summary of your answer in other words and give the i'rab of one sentence. Group B (1AA0): say your answer aloud in a breakout and answer one follow-up question.
questions.a: Group A: accurate summary and i'rab; Group B: fluent spoken answer
A) فِي فُنْدُقٍ قَرِيبٍ مِنَ الحَرَمِ. نَزَلْنَا فِي فُنْدُقٍ قَرِيبٍ مِنَ الحَرَمِ.

questions.q: Think again: what makes a holiday meaningful?
questions.a: Family, learning, worship and helping others.
